name: Fujiwara no Akisuke
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 79); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. c. 1155.

poems.title: See, how the wind of autumn drives
poems.author: Fujiwara no Akisuke
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 79
poems.text:
See, how the wind of autumn drives
The clouds to left and right,
While in between the moon peeps out,
Dispersing with her light
The darkness of the night.
